_notes: DISABLED BY DEFAULT. Enable deliberately by removing the '_disabled' field (see HACKATHON.md).
Opt-in: it does nothing unless BRAINROT_AUTO_LESSON=true is set or the task explicitly asks for a video.
Asks first: generating a video spends speech credits, so the hook asks before calling generate_short_video.
No self-trigger loop: this fires on PostTaskExec (a spec-task status change). Making a video is MCP tool calls, not a task status change, so it cannot re-fire PostTaskExec on itself.
Never blocks coding: if the Brainrotten companion is unreachable, skip silently.

action.prompt: A spec task was just completed. Do nothing unless BRAINROT_AUTO_LESSON=true is set or the task explicitly asked for a video; otherwise stop here. When opted in: pick the format (systems/architecture/bug/change -> sketch; concept or misconception -> skit; a real diff -> prreview; options weighed -> tierlist; a literal conversation -> groupchat), call get_video_formats for that format and copy its storyExample structure, and write the full script from the real change (never invent code, test results or metrics). Because a video spends speech credits, ASK the user for confirmation before generating. Only after they confirm, call validate_video_script, fix every issue, then call generate_short_video once and report the job id. If the Brainrotten companion is not reachable, skip silently. Do not start another video from this hook.
